independent_solution.main_law_or_principle: Resistance of a wire $R = \rho L / A$ and Power in parallel $P = V^2 / R$.
independent_solution.calculation_or_logic: 1. Resistance ratio: $R_Y / R_X = (L_Y / L_X) \times (A_X / A_Y) = (2) \times (r_X^2 / r_Y^2) = 2 \times (1 / 0.5)^2 = 2 \times 4 = 8$. Thus $R_Y = 8R_X$. 2. Power ratio: Since $V$ is constant in parallel, $P_Y / P_X = R_X / R_Y = 1 / 8$.

required_physics_moves: Identify constant voltage in parallel circuits

notes: The question is well-posed and tests fundamental understanding of electrical properties and circuit configurations.
